name: Papercut Art
author: TBIT DESIGN - Thomas Breher
description: Layered paper art from photos, editable landscapes and sculptural cut-paper compositions. Start with the current document or build a scene from the searchable library, then move, rotate, recolor, duplicate and punch out individual objects, with undo and redo for every step. Smooth, fibrous, cotton, linen, watercolor, laid, pearlescent and metallic paper have procedural surfaces; paper thickness, directional cut-edge highlights, soft cast shadows and contact shadows create depth. Drag the light in two dimensions, mix materials and spacing per sheet, and use multi-stop color palettes. New paper sculptures include layered organic vaults, petal windows, gilded arches and twisted geometric apertures. The library contains landscapes, plants, architecture, frames and lettering, animals from the forest, the farm, the savanna, the polar ice, the sea and the age of dinosaurs, castles, townhouses, a fairground and holiday motifs, and the editor's own shapes cut from paper, with real rendered previews for scenes, palettes and surfaces and a theme filter to find them. Photos can be sliced by brightness or by the editor's optional local depth model, and the local subject cutout can lift a subject onto a front sheet. Nothing is uploaded. Insert an editable group with a transparent image per paper sheet and reopen the saved scene to continue editing.
